credits.title: Do Me a Favor
credits.overview: On a late night, two lonely and disgruntled individuals cross paths in downtown Tallahassee and create an unlikely friendship.

credits.title: The Division
credits.overview: The Division employs time agents to go and fix events from the past to make a better future. Presented in a mockumentary style, this project was created as part of a 48 hour film competition to make a trailer for a non-existent movie.

credits.title: Pine
credits.overview: A group of friends reunite after lockdown and reflect upon what happened during the quarantine in their own lives.
